_doc: Terminal theme rail baseline — read by pages/terminal/themeColours.rail.test.js.
exceptions = genuine fixed colours, each with its reason; debt = colours that should follow the theme and do not yet.
SHRINK-ONLY: a file may never gain a literal; when one is removed, lower its count here in the same commit (the rail reds until you do).

components/CompanyLogo.module.css.why: The white plate under a third-party company logo: brand logos are drawn for a white ground.

components/NavBar.module.css.why: The "UCT" wordmark green is sampled from the compass logo PNG (a fixed asset), so it is a fixed hex on every theme.

components/calendar/TranscriptSearchAll..why: Categorical hues for arbitrary search terms (no direction); the chart host nudges each to 3:1 on the live surface.

components/research-kit/charts/echartsCo.why: CHART_INK: the dark-theme literals the chart host swaps for resolved tokens at render (resolveThemeColor) — the jsdom fallback, never what a browser paints.

components/research/sections/statementSe.why: Categorical series hues (revenue / op income / ...); the research-kit chart host nudges each to 3:1 on the live surface.

components/ui/UIcon.jsx.why: The brand gold emboss gradient (CLAUDE.md "UI Icons"); gold={false} gives currentColor where a surface needs it.

components/voice/CompassOrb.jsx.why: Brand artwork: the Compass orb medallion and its state glyph colours.

constants/tagColors.js.why: The seven member-picked ticker tag colours: identity data the member chose, not chrome.

pages/Breadth.module.css.why: The heat ladder (.bgG3...bgR3) is pinned byte-equal to tokens.css --heat-* by styles/tokens.test.js; translucent, so it composites on any ground.

pages/BreadthCharts.jsx.why: The follow-through-day violet, an identity hue drawn through readable() = ensureContrast against the live surface.

pages/ThemeTrackerPage.module.css.why: The /charts workspace "sunrise" chart-theme variant ([data-charts-theme]), a theme of its own, not the app theme.

pages/Watchlists.module.css.why: The /charts workspace "sunrise" chart-theme variant ([data-charts-theme]), a theme of its own, not the app theme.

pages/breadth/breadthShare.js.why: The exported Breadth share PNG is a fixed brand card, the same image whatever theme the sharer wears.

pages/breadth/chartMetrics.js.why: MA-breadth extreme-line and tone data inks; BreadthChartsV2 passes them through readable() (extremeInks) per theme.

pages/breadth/v2/BreadthChartsV2.jsx.why: The jsdom surface fallback used only when no token resolves (t.text empty).

pages/breadth/v2/chartOption.js.why: DEFAULT_CHROME / LIGHT_CHROME: fallbacks for a caller that does not resolve tokens (tests); BreadthChartsV2 hands in useThemeInk-resolved chrome.

pages/breadth/views/breadthViewShared.js.why: The four selectable Breadth View data palettes; useViewColors nudges every tier ink to 3:1 on a light surface.

pages/cot/cotPalette.js.why: COT trader-group HUES (the one authority); useCotPalette nudges each to 3:1 on the live surface and swaps the neutrals for text tokens.

pages/terminal/boardModel.js.why: Link-group (A-D) and channel identity colours: a group is recognised by its hue across every panel, like a tag colour.

utils/dividerColor.js.why: Menu chrome is theme-INVARIANT by owner decision (2026-07-30, tokens.css --menu-*): MENU_THEME here is the JS mirror of that block.

components/research/EarningsResearchModa.why: THEME ISLAND: the earnings research modal pins every themed token to its dark :root value, so it stays dark under light themes. Owner decision pending (the ruling says every panel follows the theme; the island was a deliberate fix).

pages/breadth/heatmapMetrics.js.why: Treemap tier fills are OPAQUE DARK tiles carrying their own white ink: legible, but dark on a light page. Owner decision pending (translucent --heat-* tiles would follow the theme).

pages/breadth/views/TreemapView.jsx.why: The white tile ink and amber notable border that pair with heatmapMetrics.js opaque dark tiles (same decision).
